answer: Admission requires a 24-unit bond locked for 10 epochs. A public forge groups applicants by funding graph and execution fingerprint; the nth linked identity posts 24n² units and waits n extra rounds. Independent beacons named juniper and walnut seed a nine-auditor draw, and six auditors must replay the signed work log. A failed replay burns 75%, making each clone costlier in capital and time under publicly reproducible checks.
